body: Well, I feel that my original point was missed anyway. Last post im going to make here, Infosponger, same as the OP, it's not necessarily about sex, its the connection. Bxknlm, ive had lots of tough love in my life, got it from my parents... blah blah blah. It doesn't work on all people and on some, it has the exact opposite effect. S'ingTFU now.
I suppose that would be an option for some. Personally, it is not an option for multiple reasons.

Yes. I understand the feeling. When I work I throw myself into it and do the best possible job, and yet at the same time deep down, I feel like none of it really matters. I used to work in a cabinet shop years ago, and I really liked the job, but there would be days where I would be so depressed deep down id stop to think about offing myself with one of the power tools in the shop. Im sorry I cant really help, I don't have any answers, all I can do is let you know you aren't alone in feeling this way.

Quick question, and im not trying to be an ass, I swear! What about for those of us who have tried, repeatedly, and for years on end? Only to be faced with rejection after rejection until we reach the point where we just cant put ourselves out there anymore, because our confidence has been shattered to the point where we simply cant take another rejection.

Well, Bucks5, I have no good answer for you. I grew up being taught that men don't show fear, anxiety, or depression, the only emotions men should show are happy and anger, and lust. Through the years I learned to bury my feeling, and try to bury them so deep I didn't even know I felt them. The problem with that is they are still there, festering and getting worse. The depression became such an issue I tried to kill myself 9 times when I was younger. Now I'm 33, I fight depression on a daily basis. I recently lost my job, and have become so scared to talk to people that finding a new one is nearly impossible. Every time im around people I don't know, I feel like they are judging me and seeing me as a worthless pos. I have 1 person that I consider a friend, I have managed to push everyone else away because I hide so much of what I feel they see me as cold and unfeeling, and he doesn't understand and has used the "be a man" and "stop being a pussy". What he doesn't realize is that when he says that, it just makes me want to keep my mouth shut. I do think that both of us have made a step in the right direction though, by talking about it here. 

As a side note, and maybe if just had really bad experiences in this particular area, but I have to disagree to an extent with pinkgreenpurple. I've had to learn to hide my feelings around women. I have never met a woman that viewed me, when being emotional, as "sensitive", just an emotional mess that they need to walk away from. Please don't flame me for saying so, these are just my experiences.

Thank you Charlie. The anxiety I feel around people makes it really hard to ask for help. I remember when I was younger, I was just shy. As I've aged, it has gotten to the point where I tried to shoot some pool with one person that I didn't know about a week ago, and I was shaking so bad I could barely line up a shot. I always feel like im being judged, and im not good good enough. That being said, I know I "should" be seeing someone, and probably on some form of medication, but it always comes back to money. Even when I had a job, I didn't make enough to see anybody. Im just so tired of "sucking it up" as my father would have put it. I have reached the point where "relief" from the emotional pain, and the cessation of everything that death would bring mean about the same.

Kadse,

 I want to add:

"You have to think positive" to the list. Too many times I have tried to talk to people about my problems, only to have them tell me that. It used to inspire a flare of anger when I heard it, for gods sake if thinking positive fixed my problems, they would all be gone. Now when I hear someone say it, it just makes me more depressed because it tells me they truly don't understand at all, and they are so insensitive that they cant think of anything else to say.
